chunks: "Have no fear," they said. "We bring you news of a son full of wisdom."

key_terms.تَوْجَلْ: Do not be anxious or fearful

ai.seo_question: What did the angels tell Prophet Zakariyyah when they brought him the news of his son?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Maryam, the angels deliver glad tidings to Prophet Zakariyyah (AS) of a son named Yahya, emphasizing that Allah grants wisdom and prophethood even when natural means are exhausted. This highlights the Shia theological emphasis on divine grace (fadl) and the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt, as Yahya is often linked to the lineage of prophets who would later include the Imams. The reassurance 'do not fear' underscores the transition from human limitation to divine capability, a key theme in understanding the miracles of the prophets.
